pitch: Your new client ran unsuccessfully for the same council seat in 2009, 2013 and 2017. He has a PowerPoint. It is forty slides long and it is called MOMENTUM.
candidateBlurb: Retired driving instructor, fourth attempt at the seat. Believes the electorate has been 'warming to him' since 2009. Travels everywhere with a laser pointer.

objectives.label: Reach 38% vote share (he has never cleared 27%)
Keep Malcolm upright (morale above 25 on election day)

keepMessage: Malcolm is ecstatic. He adds a forty-first slide, titled YOU, and emails it to you at 3am. The cheque clears on the second attempt.
sackMessage: Malcolm thanks you for your service in a reply-all to the entire allotment society. He is already drafting 2027.

requires.label: Recognition 15 or below — only operators nobody has heard of return Malcolm's calls
